subject: POC intake — workshop roster, smoke-run plan & stakeholder sync
thread_text:
From: Lyla Hart <lyla@novusfinancial.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan@novusfinancial.com>
Subject: Re: POC — workshop & hands-on run coordination

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we had great internal buzz. We'd like to lock in the POC kickoff and the hands-on sessions (prompt review, routing, and a short smoke-load run) for the week of July 12. Key goals:
- Understand routing behavior for our mixed-traffic prompts
- Validate latency under a simulated burst (10–20 RPS for 30s)
- Walk through role responsibilities and acceptance criteria

Attendees on our side: Lyla (product lead), Ethan (platform), plus one from procurement may join for timelines. Our preferred times are July 12–14, morning PST. Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood should attend (technical lead, solutions engineer, account lead)?

Thanks,
Lyla
Product Lead, Novus Financial

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 16:50:00 -0700
To: Lyla Hart <lyla@novusfinancial.com>
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from demo

Hi Lyla — happy to. I'm looping in Karthik (technical lead) and Marissa (solutions) to propose a runbook and times. I'll also attach a draft agenda and a short smoke-run checklist so your team knows what we'll simulate.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
To: Lyla Hart <lyla@novusfinancial.com>, Ethan Moore <ethan@novusfinancial.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: RE: POC intake — workshop roster, smoke-run plan & stakeholder sync

Thanks, Lyla — happy to confirm. Proposed plan:
1) Kickoff call (30m) — introductions, goals, success criteria, scheduling the hands-on days
   - Proposed slot A: Tue, Jul 13 10:00–10:30 PT
   - Proposed slot B: Wed, Jul 14 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Hands-on working session (90m) — prompt review, routing config, accept. criteria review
   - Wed, Jul 14 11:00–12:30 PT (can split into two 45m blocks if preferred)
3) Smoke-load run (30m) — controlled burst and quick metrics review
   - Wed, Jul 14 14:00–14:30 PT

Internal attendees from Redwood:
- Karthik Iyer (Technical Lead) — will drive routing config and monitor KV/cache behavior
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) — prompt design and acceptance criteria walk-through
- Connor O'Brien (Support/On-call) — will own fallback routing during smoke run

I've attached a draft PoC_Workshop_Agenda.pdf and Smoke_Run_Checklist.md. If those windows work, I'll send calendar invites and a short mutual action plan.

Best,
Stephanie

On Sun, 27 Jun 2027 at 11:30 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

> Stephanie / Lyla —
>
> Thanks for the outline. A couple of technical notes before we lock times:
> - For the smoke run, we should define sample sequences and a cold-start case (no cached KV) + warm case.
> - We'll provision a dedicated test model variant with consistent quantization profile to match Novus's CPU/GPU targets.
> - Can Novus confirm whether the payloads will include tool-calls (yes/no) and average sequence length?
>
> Proposed tweak: start hands-on session at 11:30 PT to give Novus time to settle after kickoff. Otherwise all good.
>
> Cheers,
> Karthik
>
On Mon, 28 Jun 2027 at 11:00 AM, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

> Pushed calendar hold to Jul 14 11:30–13:00 PT (tentative) to align with Karthik's suggestion.
> Also added the Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx to the thread — contains roles, prework, and acceptance criteria.
>
> Quick ask for Novus: please share a short list (2–3) of representative prompts and expected outputs ahead of the hands-on so we can pre-seed any caches.
>
> —Marissa

On Mon, 28 Jun 2027 at 14:20, Lyla Hart <lyla@novusfinancial.com> wrote:

> Thanks — Jul 14 works but can we shift the kickoff to 11:00 PT and the hands-on to 11:30 PT same day? Procurement may join the kickoff and needs the morning blocked.
>
> Also, Ethan will send a sample prompt set by EOD tomorrow. Procurement may route paperwork the same day.
>
> Lyla
